41.
(1) The Authority shall have the power –

(a)
to  receive  any  complaint  or  information  on  any
alleged violation or denial, or imminent violation
or denial, of any right or entitlement of a victim of
crime or witness under this Act;

(b)
for the purpose of conducting an investigation or
inquiry  into  any  alleged  violation  or  denial,  or
imminent  violation  or  denial,  of  any  right  or
entitlement of a victim of crime or witness under
this Act, to -

(i)
require  any  person,  other  than  a  judicial
officer or Commissioner of a Commission, to
appear before the Authority and to participate
in such investigation or inquiry;

(ii)
require  any  person,  other  than  a  court  or
Commission, to produce before the Authority
any  document,  a  certified  copy  of  any
document  or  any  other  material  in  the
possession  or  custody  of  such  person,
including  any  report  of  investigation  or
inquiry,  an  extract  of  an  information  book
and extract of Police Officers’ Visiting Book
for examination and to take copies thereof;
